meta.title: Vacuum — real clutter found in Drive
meta.capturedFrom: Google Drive scan, 2026-06-16 (the same scan that found Lyfe scattered under three names)
meta.doctrine: Read-only findings. Every action is backup-first, reversible, and runs only after you approve it in the Mac build. Nothing here has been touched.
meta.note: Byte sizes are exact where Drive reported them (identical sizes = byte-for-byte duplicates). Google-native docs report no meaningful byte size, so those are framed as clarity, not space.

items.title: "Automate the Boring Stuff" zip — 2 identical copies
items.detail: Both copies are byte-for-byte identical (6,826,503 B each). One is in a different folder than the other — a classic re-download instead of a move.
items.safeAction: Keep the newest copy, move the older into _Backup/_dedup/ (not deleted). Reversible.

items.title: "TODO#1_WaterlooIOWA.xlsx" — 2 identical copies
items.detail: Both 1,631,979 B, identical. Same spreadsheet saved into two project folders.
items.safeAction: Keep one canonical copy, link the other; archive the duplicate to _Backup/_dedup/.

items.title: "_Workflow" doc — 4 identical copies (incl. "Copy of _Workflow")
items.detail: The same content-creation workflow doc exists 4× across different folders. Splitting it means edits never stay in sync.
items.safeAction: Promote one to a single canonical _Workflow, replace the others with a shortcut/link, archive the rest. Clarity, not space.

items.title: Todoist backup zips — 4 generations kept
items.detail: Backups from 2026-04-30, 2026-04-29, 2023-08-18, 2023-06-03. Keeping the latest + one milestone is plenty.
items.where: Drive · Todoist - LIFE LYFE Projects / _LYFE Projects
items.safeAction: Keep newest (2026-04-30) + oldest milestone (2023-06-03); move the middle two to _Backup/_archive/.

items.title: LIFE Tree Master Tracker — 2 drifting copies
items.detail: Two versions of the 138-project index exist; they've already drifted (different project counts). One should be the source of truth.
members: LIFE Tree Master Tracker — Project Index (138 projects, current)
LIFE Tree Master Tracker — Project Index (older)
items.safeAction: Mark the 138-project one canonical; archive the older. Lyfe already reads the canonical one.

items.title: Lyfe lives under three folder names
items.detail: _ProjectZ, 'Todoist - LIFE LYFE Projects', and _LYFE Projects all hold pieces of the same effort. The fragmentation is the very thing Lyfe exists to heal.
items.safeAction: Choose one canonical home (suggest _ProjectZ/_LYFE), move the others under it as dated subfolders. Backup the whole tree first.
